scorePolicy:
Basis for Assignment the Course Grades:
1. Each case/article reading reports 35% (individual work)
一頁word/單行間距/字數不限/英文撰寫/課堂時會邀請同學分享
One page of word/single line spacing/no limit on word count/written in English/students will be invited to share in class.
2. Final Project Presentation 40% (Group work)
● 每個小組需針對受邀參加本課程的企業主開展一個項目實務專題製作，並每週在課堂上進行討論。
Each group conducts a project targeted at the business owners invited for this course and discusses it in class every week.
● 期末針對此專案進行報告
Each group will report on the project plan at the end of the semester.
3. Final Exam (peer review) 25%
